nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive documentation for the waggle-memory-mcp package, an MCP server providing persistent memory to Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and any MCP-compatible AI system, covering installation, tools (14 MCP tools), resources, architecture, embedding provider chain, and environment variables.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the waggle-memory-mcp npm package, an MCP server binary exposing persistent memory capabilities powered by the Waggle OS memory engine, with dependencies on @waggle/core, @waggle/shared, @waggle/wiki-compiler, and the MCP SDK.
nodes.languageNotes: Published as an ESM module with a CLI binary entry point (waggle-memory-mcp), making it installable via npx without any setup.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the memory-mcp package, targeting ES2022 with strict mode, composite project references, and declaration map generation for use within the monorepo.
